Key upper-left-front #ffe9d0, rim back-right #9fe8ff, ambient #16233a. Controlled broad brush planes, coloured local-hue dark edges without black outlines. Edit target: supplied battlefield render. GEOMETRY-LOCKED PAINTERLY FINISH ONLY. Keep exact camera, image framing, central dais ellipse, circular sockets at exactly same pixels, ALL six road courses and widths, every pillar/brazier/tree/cliff outline and occupied location. No new objects or paths or node lights. Change ONLY surface rendering: make it solemn ancient hand-painted basalt and worn flagstone, chipped planar brush marks, subtle carved notches, broad mottled ash, muted teal lichen texture, aged stone grain. Ruins look carved/worn rather than smooth geometric toys, tree bark and ivy brush texture (no new branches). Strong controlled brushwork 2.5D, not photorealistic, avoid tiny detail noise. SAME dark values15-45% and desaturated palette, key upper-left #ffe9d0 cool rim #9fe8ff ambient #16233a, no brighter road glow. Preserve clear lanes/nodes. Same edge #1d1f24 and muted wine cracks. No characters/Crystal/VFX/text. Output landscape matching target2400x1360 aspect exactly, at least2400x1360 if possible. This is a material paint-over; never move geometry.
